title: Review: combining conditions
idea: Consolidate and/or/not alongside if/elif/else and the edge-case habit. Review-leaning final lesson of the sub-lap.

exercises.explanation: Review: 'and' needs both sides True. One False makes it False.

options: at least one side is True
exercises.explanation: Review: 'or' needs just one True side.

options: Flips True to False and False to True
exercises.explanation: Review: 'not' reverses a condition - great for 'unless' rules.
a and b is False (b is False), but a or b is True, so the elif prints 'At least one'. Operators combine with elif chains.

exercises.prompt: Match each English rule to its operator.
exercises.explanation: Both to and, either to or, unless to not. This mapping is the heart of the unit.

exercises.prompt: Recall from Unit 24: before dividing total by count, you should...
exercises.explanation: The edge-case habit still applies: guard the zero count before dividing.

exercises.prompt: Which condition means 'score is between 50 and 100 inclusive'?
exercises.explanation: 'Between, inclusive' needs both bounds at once, joined with 'and'.
'or' lets either a VIP or a pass-holder enter.
'not True' is False, so the else runs: 'Open'. 'not' flipped the condition.

exercises.prompt: The big win of this sub-lap (Units 19-26) is...
options: making real decisions: yes/no, two outcomes, several buckets, and combined conditions
exercises.explanation: You can now sense a yes/no fact, choose between outcomes, sort into buckets, and combine conditions with and/or/not. That is real decision-making!
